scenario: 公交清分 · 交易级结算补记样例（复算后一笔交易换公司）

models.name: dwd_card_transaction_detail
models.description: 刷卡交易明细宽表：清洗城市内刷卡交易
models.sql: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transaction_id, t.card_id AS card_id, t.line_id AS line_id, t.vehicle_id AS vehicle_id, t.transaction_time AS transaction_time, t.amount AS amount FROM ods_card_transaction t WHERE t.city_code = '3301'

models.name: ads_transaction_settlement
models.description: 交易级结算明细：每笔交易一行，输出交易号、结算公司与结算金额（整数分）
models.sql: SELECT d.transaction_id AS transaction_id, l.company_id AS company_id, d.amount AS settlement_amount FROM dwd_card_transaction_detail d INNER JOIN dim_bus_line l ON d.line_id = l.line_id WHERE l.line_type = 'BUS'
